# AI-use disclosure

> **Team action needed:** the paragraph below accurately describes the AI-generated build. Each member must add
> how *they* used AI (or state that they did not) in the table at the end before submission. A missing disclosure
> caps the assignment at 60/70.

**How we used AI.** The SilverFile code base in this repository was generated by **Claude Code** (Anthropic's
coding agent, in a cloud session operated by one team member). It worked from
two planning documents the team prepared with AI assistance (*SilverFile Complete Implementation Plan* and a
Claude Code handoff prompt) plus the assignment text. Claude Code wrote essentially all of the application:
* the LangGraph graph and the seven agent roles;
* the deterministic 2025 tax calculations and the MCP server/client;
* the cited rule registry, policy and source manifest;
* the fixture generator that fills the official blank IRS forms with fictional data;
* the offline OCR reader;
* the PDF writer;
* the Streamlit taxpayer, dashboard and provenance views;
* the service layer, CLI, Dockerfile and context-benchmark harness;
* the test suite and this documentation.

It also chose the interpretations recorded in `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md`. The reference PDFs in
`data/reference_tax_forms` were gathered by a team member with AI help and were not supplied by the professor;
Claude Code checked their identity (PDF titles and key passages, hashes in `data/source_manifest.json`) and cited
specific pages, but did not verify where they were downloaded from. Verification during the build was automated
and done by the AI, not yet by people:
* the tax function was checked against every row of the printed 2025 IRS Tax Table parsed from the instructions PDF;
* tax-worksheet results were compared with independent oracle formulas;
* eight cases were compared with expected results that Claude Code worked out by hand separately from the
  production code (so they are AI-produced and need human re-checking);
* the full system was run end to end, including in a browser and in Docker.

No live Anthropic API runs were made during the build (no key was available in the build environment), so the
live model paths were tested only with a fake client, and the context-window token measurements in
`docs/metrics.md` have not yet been run. All taxpayer data is fictional, and no real taxpayer information was
given to any AI tool. Team members are responsible for reviewing, testing, correcting and extending this baseline
and for recording that work below; nothing in this repository should be read as human-reviewed unless a member's
entry says so.

## Where AI runs inside SilverFile (runtime, not development)

When `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set, the agents call the Anthropic Messages API (model from `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`) to
interpret taxpayer replies, read document images, screen descriptions for out-of-scope items, critique the
assembled return, explain lines, and draft a reviewer cover note. Model output is validated against fixed
schemas. It never produces a dollar amount on the return: every amount comes from a document box, a dated answer
or an MCP calculation.
